title: macos: fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Un client non verifica un certificato firmato da una CA interna legittima (root mancante nel trust store). Aggiungi la fiducia in modo mirato e sicuro. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA'
expected_reasoning: Verification failure against a legitimate internal CA means the client is missing the CA root, not a bad cert.
Confirm the CA is trusted and add its root to the CLIENT trust store (system or app-specific), scoped correctly.
Keep verification ON; verify the handshake now succeeds with trust in place.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix a client that can't verify a certificate signed by an internal CA

possible_mistakes: Disable verification instead of trusting the internal CA.
hints: The fix is adding the internal ROOT to the trust store, not disabling verify.
Scope to the right trust store.
reference_solution: Confirm the internal CA is legitimate
Add its root to the client trust store
Verify the handshake with trust on
alternative_solution: Distribute the internal CA root via config management to all clients.
edge_cases: An app uses its own trust bundle, ignoring the system store.
